items.title: Perk Makes BOLD Proclamation About Caleb Wilson—Channing Isn’t Buying It
items.body_excerpt: Kendrick Perkins says the Chicago Bulls have found their next Derrick Rose. Channing Frye immediately wants whatever Perk is drinking. The Road Trippin’ crew debates whether Chicago can climb into the Eastern Conference’s top eight, and Perk isn’t backing down. Channing…
